reviewMethod: Read the canonical guide, attribution fix, and actor audit in full.
Read every stored headword-bearing case/unit and distinguished utterer, questioner, respondent, narrator, paratext, title, and contained-only material.
Reran zc.verify for every stored KWIC and required exact FromLb/ToLb plus headword containment.
Retested English-first prose, corpus-earned inference, #0g, sense boundaries, recurrence/work independence, aliases, and quote anchoring.
Bound every decision to the repair-author ledger and current entry SHA-256; edited and promoted nothing.
summaryFinding: All 21 entries share a hard generic-prose failure, and source reading found additional exact-turn, lexical-boundary, contained-only, bare-token, recurrence, and sense/deployment defects. The author repair improved mechanical exactness but did not produce reader-ready lexicography or reliable actor assignment.
